title: Dr. Shakunthala C
content:
Dr. Shakunthala C

Education Details:

  • Ph. D( Electrical and Electronics Engineering Sciences )
  • M. Tech (Computer Applications in Industrial drives)
  • B. E( Electrical and Electronics Engineering)

 

Professional Experience

  1. Worked as an Assistant Professor at VidyaVikas Institute of Engineering and Technology Mysuru, from July 2012 to November 2017.
  2. Worked as an Assistant Professor at National Institute of Engineering Mysuru, from August 2018 to July 2019
  3. Working as an Associate Professor at ATME College of Engineering Mysuru, from April 2021 to till date

Total: 7 Years

 

Publication Details:

  1. Shakunthala C, Dr. SurekhaManoj, “Energy Harvesting from Dairy and Hospital Wastewater using Microbial Fuel Cell (MFC)” Springer, pp 440-446.
  2. Shakunthala C, Dr. SurekhaManoj, “Comparative Study on Different Electrodes to Improve Performance of Microbial Fuel Cells (MFC)” International Journal of Application or Innovation in Engineering and Management (IJAIEM), Volume 6, Issue 10, October 2017, ISSN 2319-4847.
  3. Shakunthala C, Dr. SurekhaManoj, “Microbial Fuel Cell (MFC) for Energy Production from Wastewater: A Review” International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR) Vol. 6, Issue 9, September 2017 ISSN (Online): 2319-7064
  4. Shakunthala C, Dr. SurekhaManoj, “Energy Harvesting using Microbial Fuel Cell (MFC)” National Journal Bonfring, Vol. 3, Issue 2, Dr. AIT Bangalore during April 23rd -24th
  5. Divya B N, Shakunthala C, “ Design and Testing of 10W SSPA based S band Transmitting module” International Research Journal of Engineering and Technology (IRJET), Volume 6, Issue 5, May 2019.
  6. Lavanya D C, Shakunthala C, “ Hob Grinding Machine Automation using PLC and HMI” International Research Journal of Engineering and Technology (IRJET), Volume 6, Issue 5, May 2019.
